verdict: A very close, well-structured rebuild whose main gap is the bottom of the screen: the Liquid Glass tab bar is opaque, with no blurred content behind it and no fade on the third Top read row.

top_defects.where: tab bar and the bottom of the feed
top_defects.what: reference tab bar is translucent glass that shows the blurred 'Liste de ... de Wikimedia' text behind it, and the third Top read row fades out to light grey; the candidate's capsule is opaque white and row 3 ('Star Academy', '3', description) is drawn at full contrast

top_defects.where: "Today" large title and the whole feed below it
top_defects.what: "Today" sits about 12 px (4 pt) lower than in the reference; the segmented control is about 3 px lower, and the section headers, cards and rows below drift 3-6 px down, so the heatmap doubles almost every text edge

Inter stands in for SF Pro: the glyph shapes and widths differ slightly ('Community' and 'Which came first?' look heavier and wider), the titles are a little bigger, and the description wraps at 'mus...' instead of 'mu...'

top_defects.where: Top read #3 thumbnail and the card header
top_defects.what: Star Academy logo is shown whole and at full contrast, where the reference shows a faded crop ('tar / ader'); the calendar glyph and the filled Activity clock are bolder than in the reference

strengths: Every block and text of the reference is there, including the status bar details (silent bell, 39 % battery), the 'Card hidden · Undo' banner, the real thumbnails and the clipped second Top read title
Measured colors are respected: #3366cc links and rank circles, #72777d secondary text, #f8f9fa banner, blue selected Home tab on a grey capsule
Clean, named hierarchy with auto-layout for the feed, sections, cards and rows, plus components for the section header, game event row and Top read row reused as instances
